title: Supply Chain Attack on logtrace
technical_mechanism: -- # `logtrace` was removed from crates.io for malicious code `logtrace` appeared to be downloading a RAT. The malicious crate had 2 versions published on 2026-04-01 that had a total of 30 downloads. There were no crates depending on this crate on crates.io. Thanks to [Socket.dev](https://socket.dev/)
